name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Set your feet roughly shoulder width apart, or slightly wider if comfortable. Shoulders relaxed. Hands can be relaxed by your side, behind the head or crossed on your chest. Toes can be pointed outward slightly if comfortable. With torso upright, sink into the hole until thighs are roughly parallel with the ground, weight distributed evenly through the foot. Fire the quads and glutes as you come out of the hole, keeping your chest up while doing so.

name: Barbell Squat
instructions: Set feet roughly shoulder width, toes slightly outward if comfortable. Grip the barbell at comfortable hand width (i.e., index fingers on the rings), lightly pressing the bar into your upper traps. With torso upright, sink into the hole until thighs are parallel with the ground, weight distributed evenly through your feet. Pressing through your heels and balls of feet, fire glutes and quads to return to starting position, keeping chest upright.

name: Box Squat
instructions: Set feet as you normally would for a bodyweight squat, roughly half a foot in front of the box. Hands can be crossed on the chest, or holding dumbbells/kettlebells for increased resistance. Weight evenly distributed through your feet, sink into the hole until your glutes contact the box. Pause momentarily, but don't fully relax. Rise off the box, firing glutes and quads to do so, returning to start position. This exercise can optionally be done with a barbell.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Grip one (or two) kettlebell(s) by its handle, letting the bell rest in front of your pelvis with shoulders down and pulled back. Chest upright. Throw the bell in front of you while firmly gripping the handle, beginning the bell arc. Push the bell into its downward arc, pushing your glutes back and hinging at the hips, bending knees slightly while doing so and evenly distributing weight through the feet. At the arc's bottom, fire the glutes and extend hips while swinging the bell in front of you, keeping arms straight and shoulders back.

name: Kettlebell Squat
instructions: Set feet roughly shoulder width apart, toes optionally pointed slightly outward. Hold bell handle by its sides with both hands, gripping firmly in front of your chest with elbows tucked, shoulders back and chest upright. For alternate grip, flip the bell upside down and hold the round bell between your palms. Weight evenly distributed through your feet, sink into the hole until thighs are parallel with the ground. Fire glutes and quads to rise out of the hole, pressing through your heels and balls of feet while chest remains upright.

name: Belt Squat
instructions: With plates loaded and belt set to correct height, step into the belt and walk your feet backward on the platform until the belt is firmly pressed into your lower back. Release the weight crutch with core engaged, feet roughly shoulder width apart and toes optionally pointed slightly outward. Sink into the hole with chest upright until thighs break parallel with the ground, weight evenly distributed through feet, arms reaching in front with hands gripping the crutch for stability. Fire out of the hole (glutes, quads, core, and calves engaged) with chest upright, returning to start position.

name: Barbell Benchpress
instructions: Sit on the bench, facing away from the barbell. Lean your torso back onto the bench, eyes slightly in front of the bar. Grip the barbell firmly; a wider grip focuses chest, whereas narrow will focus triceps. With core engaged, press feet firmly into the floor, firing the hips. Pinching shoulder blades back into the bench, unrack the weight with locked elbows, bringing the bar out in line with the chest. Lower bar onto the chest while keeping core tight and shoulder blades retracted, elbows roughly at a 45 degree angle. Touch down, and press up using the pectorals until elbows are locked, shoulder blades still retracted.

name: Dumbbell Arnold Press
instructions: Pick up your dumbbells; start moderately light. Curl dumbbells toward your chin and keep them there. This is starting position. With glutes squeezed and core tight, press the dumbbells overhead, rotating hands and forearms 180 degrees evenly through the movement. Reverse the motion, lowering the bells and rotating back to start position.
